tools.name: calculate_ampullary_cancer_staging
tools.description: Calculate ampullary (Vater) cancer TNM staging (AJCC/UICC 8th edition)

t_stage.description: T stage: Tis=carcinoma in situ; T1a=limited to ampulla of Vater or sphincter of Oddi; T1b=extends beyond sphincter into duodenal submucosa; T2=invades duodenal muscularis propria; T3a=invades pancreas ≤0.5 cm; T3b=invades pancreas >0.5 cm; T4=involves celiac axis, superior mesenteric artery, or common hepatic artery

n_stage.description: N stage: N0=no nodal metastasis; N1=1-3 regional lymph node metastases; N2=4 or more regional lymph node metastases

m_stage.description: M stage: M0=no distant metastasis; M1=distant metastasis

tools.description: Calculate BCLC (Barcelona Clinic Liver Cancer) staging for primary hepatocellular carcinoma (CSCO 2022-based interpretation)

tools.name: calculate_cnlc_staging
tools.description: Calculate CNLC (China Liver Cancer) staging for primary hepatocellular carcinoma (CSCO 2022). Child-Pugh class is computed internally from raw inputs.

bilirubin.description: Total bilirubin in mg/dL for Child-Pugh calculation

albumin.description: Serum albumin in g/dL for Child-Pugh calculation

encephalopathy.description: Hepatic encephalopathy grade for Child-Pugh calculation

tools.name: calculate_distal_cholangiocarcinoma_staging
tools.description: Calculate distal cholangiocarcinoma TNM staging (AJCC/UICC 8th edition)

t_stage.description: T stage: Tis=carcinoma in situ; T1=depth of invasion <5 mm; T2=depth 5-12 mm; T3=depth >12 mm; T4=involves celiac axis, superior mesenteric artery, or common hepatic artery

n_stage.description: N stage: N0=no nodal metastasis; N1=1-3 regional lymph node metastases; N2=4 or more regional lymph node metastases

m_stage.description: M stage: M0=no distant metastasis; M1=distant metastasis

tools.name: calculate_duodenal_ampullary_net_staging
tools.description: Calculate duodenal and ampullary neuroendocrine tumor TNM staging (AJCC/UICC 8th edition). For well-differentiated NETs only

t_stage.description: T stage: T1=duodenal tumor confined to mucosa/submucosa and ≤1 cm, or ampullary tumor confined to sphincter of Oddi and ≤1 cm; T2=duodenal tumor invades muscularis propria or >1 cm; T3=invades pancreas or peripancreatic tissue; T4=penetrates peritoneum or invades other organs

n_stage.description: N stage: N0=no regional lymph node metastasis; N1=regional lymph node metastasis

m_stage.description: M stage: M0=no distant metastasis; M1a=liver-only metastasis; M1b=extrahepatic-only metastasis; M1c=both hepatic and extrahepatic metastases

tools.name: calculate_ecog_ps
tools.description: Calculate ECOG Performance Status score

tools.name: calculate_gallbladder_cancer_staging
tools.description: Calculate gallbladder cancer TNM staging (AJCC/UICC 8th edition)

t_stage.description: T stage: Tis=carcinoma in situ; T1a=lamina propria invasion; T1b=muscular layer invasion; T2a=peritoneal-side perimuscular connective tissue invasion; T2b=hepatic-side perimuscular connective tissue invasion; T3=perforates serosa or directly invades liver/adjacent organ; T4=involves main portal vein, hepatic artery, or at least two extrahepatic organs

n_stage.description: N stage: N0=no nodal metastasis; N1=1-3 regional lymph node metastases; N2=4 or more regional lymph node metastases

m_stage.description: M stage: M0=no distant metastasis; M1=distant metastasis

tools.name: calculate_intrahepatic_cholangiocarcinoma_staging
tools.description: Calculate intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma TNM staging (AJCC/UICC 8th edition)

t_stage.description: T stage: Tis=carcinoma in situ; T1a=solitary tumor ≤5 cm without vascular invasion; T1b=solitary tumor >5 cm without vascular invasion; T2=solitary tumor with vascular invasion or multiple tumors; T3=perforates visceral peritoneum; T4=direct invasion of local extrahepatic structures

n_stage.description: N stage: N0=no regional lymph node metastasis; N1=regional lymph node metastasis

m_stage.description: M stage: M0=no distant metastasis; M1=distant metastasis

tools.name: calculate_pancreatic_cancer_staging
tools.description: Calculate pancreatic cancer TNM staging (AJCC/UICC 8th edition). Applies to pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and other exocrine pancreatic cancers

t_stage.description: T stage: Tis=carcinoma in situ; T1=limited to pancreas ≤2 cm; T2=limited to pancreas 2-4 cm; T3=limited to pancreas >4 cm; T4=involves celiac axis, superior mesenteric artery, or common hepatic artery

n_stage.description: N stage: N0=no nodal metastasis; N1=1-3 regional lymph node metastases; N2=4 or more regional lymph node metastases

m_stage.description: M stage: M0=no distant metastasis; M1=distant metastasis

tools.name: calculate_pancreatic_net_staging
tools.description: Calculate pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor TNM staging (AJCC/UICC 8th edition). For well-differentiated pNETs only

t_stage.description: T stage: T1=limited to pancreas ≤2 cm; T2=limited to pancreas 2-4 cm; T3=limited to pancreas >4 cm or invades duodenum/bile duct; T4=invades adjacent organs or major vessels

n_stage.description: N stage: N0=no regional lymph node metastasis; N1=regional lymph node metastasis

m_stage.description: M stage: M0=no distant metastasis; M1a=liver-only metastasis; M1b=extrahepatic-only metastasis; M1c=both hepatic and extrahepatic metastases

tools.name: calculate_perihilar_cholangiocarcinoma_staging
tools.description: Calculate perihilar cholangiocarcinoma (Klatskin tumor) TNM staging (AJCC/UICC 8th edition)

t_stage.description: T stage: Tis=carcinoma in situ; T1=tumor confined to bile duct wall; T2a=extends beyond wall into surrounding adipose tissue; T2b=invades adjacent hepatic parenchyma; T3=involves unilateral portal vein or hepatic artery branches; T4=involves main portal vein trunk or bilateral branches

n_stage.description: N stage: N0=no nodal metastasis; N1=1-3 regional lymph node metastases; N2=4 or more regional lymph node metastases

m_stage.description: M stage: M0=no distant metastasis; M1=distant metastasis
